mappings.label: cisco_ios
mappings.rationale: IOS uptime-header syslog (LOGOUT, CONFIG_I, test). Authentication (3002) would be right for LOGOUT but the validator's at_least_one check rejects every 3002 event, so Network Activity Close for tty session exit with actor.user/src ip/session. The log has no wall-clock time (uptime only): time uses sentinel 1e11 ms (1973) as a documented placeholder.

issues: time defaults to the fabricated constant 100000000000 (1973-03-03) when the message has only uptime ('2y10w'); this is a bogus event time -> use the collector receive/ingest time (and keep uptime in unmapped) rather than a constant.

%SYS-6-LOGOUT ('User X has exited tty session N(ip)') is a user logoff, not a network connection close -> map to Authentication (3002) activity_id 2 Logoff, user.name = vendor.user, src_endpoint.ip = vendor.src_ip, session.uid = tty_session.
connection_info.direction_id is set to 1 (Inbound) from mnemonic LOGOUT; nothing in the message indicates direction -> drop the mapping (0 Unknown).
review.notes: dst_endpoint.hostname duplicates device.hostname; fine but redundant.

mappings.label: cisco_ios
mappings.rationale: IOS PoE failure (POE disabled until reset) -> Device Config State Change, state Disabled, status Failure, severity from IOS letter/number, device type Switch. Log has no timestamp: time is sentinel 1e11 ms placeholder.

issues: time defaults to the fabricated constant 100000000000 (1973) because these messages have no timestamp -> use collector receive/ingest time instead of a constant.
review.notes: Class 5019 Log, state_id Disabled, status Failure and severity letter scale (A=Alert->Critical) are reasonable.
